question: In which year was the last Fundamental Duty inserted in the list of duties in the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Fundamental Duties:**

 
• **42nd Amendment Act of 1976** added **10 Fundamental Duties** to the Indian Constitution.
 
• **86th Amendment Act 2002 later added 11th Fundamental Duty** to the list. *Hence Option 1 is correct.*<
